name: charge
notes: A rush at the player: walkers run along their floor (stopping at walls and ledges), flyers fly straight at them. Shared by library monsters, Hornback and Duskflit.

name: leap
notes: Reference at horizontal speed cap; actual launch depends on target; ends on landing. Source: https://metroid.retropixel.net/games/metroid/manual/metroid1_manual.pdf Shared by library monsters and Cragjaw (which slams down with a screen shake).

name: shoot
notes: Projectile released immediately after wind-up; verify damage hitbox and execution duration. Source: https://deadcells.wiki.gg/wiki/Enemies Shared by library monsters and Murkspore (which keeps about 10 tiles away and only shoots when its last shots are gone).

name: lob
notes: Scoring reference: 20-unit horizontal target offset, vertical speed -15. Actual horizontal launch follows target. Source: https://deadcells.wiki.gg/wiki/Enemies

name: ape_scream
notes: Circle radius 5 units. Scripted opening/hurt wind-ups stay explicit.

name: ape_leap
notes: Reference: 20-unit horizontal travel in 0.75 s. Targeted speed varies. Landing slam is separate.

name: ape_retreat
notes: Only when the player is cornered (in scream range, a wall behind them, not above or below): lands at the far end of its range, away from the player, then its follow-up.

name: ape_throw
notes: Throws the ordinary log; phase two uses a splitting variant. Trajectory differs from a ceiling drop, floor impact is shared.

name: ape_slam
notes: 60 x 8 pixel landing damage rectangle; phase-two hops enlarge it.

name: ape_split
notes: On hitting the floor the parent log spawns two ordinary logs and leaves no spike itself; children never split. Both leave floor spikes.

name: ape_log
notes: Starts at rest and accelerates, capped at 17.5 units/s. Initial-speed reference model cannot assign a finite travel-time score; deliberately unscored.

name: dropwing_dive
notes: Drops straight down from its perch, speeding up to Vertical speed; climbs back at 4.5 tiles/s.

name: ossling_bone_throw
notes: Lobbed bone; the Armored variant throws two (the second higher). At most 3 bones in the air.

name: ape_spikes
notes: Persistent terrain hazard after ordinary log floor impact. Duration-based score is intentionally pending.
